{{Quote|It's nothing personal, but this sector belongs to me. You'd best tell Ompiach he'd be better off packing up and finding someplace else to pillage.|[[Safonne Pendon]], to [[Denuab Venithon|Denuab]] and [[Dorin Venithon]]|<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>}}
The '''Mieru'kar sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
The [[Hy'thor Group|Hy'thor pirate group]] operated only within this area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the Mieru'kar sector had a low population and was still not well explored.<ref name="WBC" />
